title: Chapter 1478 - 16: Beyond Transcendence (Grand Finale)
content:
Chapter 1478 - 16: Beyond Transcendence (Grand Finale)

Chapter 1478: Chapter 16: Beyond Transcendence (Grand Finale)

Lord Mo Xu, Luo Hou, and other time beings listened obediently, and their hearts stirred with ripples after receiving the answer.

On the path?

Does that mean Lin Yuan hasn’t transcended?

So powerful, yet not transcended?

Lord Mo Xu, Luo Hou, and other time beings had countless thoughts.

"Next, I will go into seclusion and won’t appear for a very long time," Lin Yuan said.

Now he has basically abandoned the path of ’endless tribulations’ as a way of transcendence, as it’s simply impossible to transcend.

He intends to devote all his energy to the endless white jade steps, at least for now, Lin Yuan still feels immense pressure when climbing the white jade steps.

The new Dao born from the fusion of five chaotic Origin Dao is still far from being able to shake the endless white jade steps themselves.

Lord Mo Xu, Luo Hou, and other time beings nodded.

Seclusion is normal for time beings.

Moreover, after today, the name of the Galaxy Lord will transcend ancient and future, and no lord would dare to provoke them.

"Chaos Void... I will make it jump out of the timeline, and be unobservable by any existence." Lin Yuan’s mind flickered, and the entire Chaos Void began to rumble.

In fact, even before comprehending the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao, Lin Yuan was able to make the Chaos Void detach from the timeline, but it was still a bit incomplete.

And now, even the will of the Supreme Rule Dao can hardly pinpoint the specific coordinates of the Chaos Void.

Under the watch of Lord Mo Xu, Luo Hou, and other time beings, Lin Yuan silently disappeared.

"Unexpectedly, the Galaxy hasn’t transcended?"

Lord Mo Xu calmed himself, his tone filled with emotion.

"For us, for other time beings, for the Time Lord, whether the Galaxy has transcended makes little difference."

Zhu Yin said.

Other time beings nodded in agreement, Lin Yuan was too powerful, powerful enough to easily obliterate all legendary lords throughout history single-handedly.

This isn’t transcendence? What is transcendence?

...

On the endless white jade steps.

Lin Yuan continues to climb unhurriedly.

"These white jade steps..."

Lin Yuan marveled in his heart that even with his current strength, the new Dao born from the fusion of five chaotic Origin Dao still perceives transformation during the climbing of the white jade steps.

"Transcendence..."

Lin Yuan’s eyes reflected a mysterious glimmer.

He hasn’t transcended yet.

In fact, he is very far from transcendence, so far that the end is unseen.

"The gap from the Thirteenth Rank to the Fourteenth Rank is just too vast."

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

If the Fourteenth Rank were equivalent to transcendence, then the Thirteenth Rank attempting to break through to the Fourteenth Rank is basically impossible; the gap is too wide.

This is why no lord on the path of Perfect Time Being has fully walked this path. They say whether you can fully walk the path of Perfect Time Being depends on fate, on one’s own path.

But this is not accurate. At least from Lin Yuan’s current height and perspective, it is clear that the real reason Perfect Time Being hasn’t seen any lord successfully transform is the vast gap.

The Twelfth Rank can break through to the Thirteenth Rank because the foundation is there.

But if a First Rank wants to directly cross into the Thirteenth Rank, the only result is being blown up.

However, the gap from the Thirteenth Rank to the Fourteenth Rank is much more exaggerated than a First Rank directly crossing into the Thirteenth Rank.

Of course, one’s path determines whether one can become a Fourteenth Rank Perfect Time Being; this is not incorrect.

If one’s path has vast potential and can easily bear the vast gaps akin to a heavenly chasm, then one can naturally transform smoothly into a Perfect Time Being.

But so far, such a path has yet to appear.

Even if it’s a path, it needs to grow; Lin Yuan’s Taiji Dao comprehended at the Second Layer wasn’t expected to transform into the Chaos Innate Five Great Dao as it is now.

...

As his thoughts turned, Lin Yuan did not slow down his pace of climbing the white jade steps.

With each step climbed, Lin Yuan’s own Origin Dao refined a bit further, his strength increased a bit further, endlessly like the white jade steps themselves.

And as the climb continued upward, the surrounding space-time gradually changed, vaguely beginning to transcend the scope of endless dimensional layers, as if the end of the white jade steps was not in the endless dimensional layers but somewhere eternally supreme.

"The current white jade steps..."

As Lin Yuan climbed, he also noticed changes in the white jade steps.

The higher the height, the deeper the white jade steps seem, just like...

the ’Myriad Realms Gate’ deep in Lin Yuan’s mind.

There are clear differences between the two, but in some respects, there are some similarities.

"The white jade steps are connected with the Myriad Realms Gate..."

Lin Yuan diverted part of his mind to sink into the depths of his mind, looking at that magnificent and towering Myriad Realms Gate.

Even now, the Myriad Realms Gate in the depths of Lin Yuan’s mind is still not the entity but rather a projected shadow.

In fact, when the path of the endless white jade steps appeared as a way of transcendence, Lin Yuan suspected it had some connection with the Myriad Realms Gate.

After all, before breaking through to become a time being, he had that strange and varied dream, in which the final scene was arriving at a supreme place through climbing the endless white jade steps, where there was an infinitely tall light gate, and leaning against the light gate was a man with closed eyes.

"Whether there’s a connection, reaching the end will reveal everything."

Lin Yuan collected his thoughts and continued climbing.

Time swiftly passed.

Ten thousand years.

One hundred thousand years.

One million years.

Five million years.

Lin Yuan continued climbing the endless white jade steps.
